newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian bourse ends steady, Unibanka firms.
newsitem.headline: Latvian bourse ends steady, Unibanka firms.

text.p: Leading bank Unibanka dominated the Latvian stock exchange again on Wednesday, regaining some ground after a recent slide and helping the overall bourse volume and index to climb.
Total turnover was 108,000 lats after 100,000 lats yesterday and the stock market index added 1.35 points to 374.73.

Dealers said that attention was still focussed on Unibanka, which added three santimes to 3.13 after sliding all the way from 3.25 lats after the privatisation agency said it would sell one million of the bank's shares at a minimum 3.05 lats on July 28.
Turnover in the bank was by far the highest on the market at 63,100 lats.
"It seems that someone is supporting the price," said one dealer. "It will be interesting to see if someone continues to prop it up."
Dealers had widely expected Unibanka to fall to 3.05 lats ahead of the July 28 auction.
On the secondary list, Jekapbils Sugar jumped 14 percent to 0.57 lats in trade of 5,400 lats as the market responded warmly to the release of its promising H1 results.

Elsewhere on the secondary list, pharmaceutical maker Olainfarm, which has been holding steady at 2.50 lats, had no orders, leading dealers to speculate that the backers who have propped it up at that price may be withdrawing their support.
